items.title: held-out `entities_with_game_components` has a disputed truth (8 or 9) and passed on a hedge; the held-out set overlaps what dev sessions read

must_fix.evidence: 2026-10-23 review: both held-out runs answered **9** (the Score resource entity counts in Bevy 0.20, where resources are entities) and passed on a trailing 'the number is 8'; number facts pass if any number in the answer is in range (evals/run.py score_fact)

items.evidence: Held-out tasks are protected checks: changing one needs the human. Proposed: settle the truth (reword to 'spawned entities, not resources' or accept 9), score the headline number, and base held-out tasks on fixture state the dev tasks never read. Until then held-out reads 2/3 clean + 1 disputed on both servers.
